caption: Weak-budget/free-exposure design diagnostic for the frozen current geometry. (a) The three B=0 free-exposure clocks and their reproduced cusp mixture on one 207,025-state finite-volume quotient. (b) The cusp derivative and the frozen inward perturbation, whose three stationary roots have max-min-max topology. (c) The complete 0.01 catalyst-weight simplex screen: 4696 controls have one sampled mode and 455 have two. This result-informed finite-grid diagnostic is neither a finite-B or continuum verification nor a trimodality claim.
